themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and extract key insights.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights various AI-powered platforms and software applications designed to assist in different aspects of research.

themes.description: Focuses on research related to the capabilities, limitations, and impact of AI-powered chatbots in various contexts.

themes.name: AI for design and research
themes.description: Examines the application of AI in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to user experience enhancement.
